integrity: The exact value is proved by an analytic classification of all isosceles-orthogonal unit pairs and an exact two-variable global maximization. The bundled checker verifies the elimination factorization and algebraic sign certificates; numerical reconstruction is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the real plane \(\ell_3^2\) and the Baronti–Bertella parameter \(p=3\). No general \(H_p(\ell_q^2)\) formula is claimed. Novelty is literature-search based and cannot exclude an unindexed source under substantially different notation.
title: Exact \(H_3\) constant of the real \(\ell_3^2\) plane
